tutorial.title: How the Frankenstein Orb Challenge Works
tutorial.subtitle: Understanding the algorithm and problem-solving approach
tutorial.overviewText: The Frankenstein Orb Challenge is inspired by graph theory and dynamic programming. You're given a set of potion recipes (like a dependency graph) and need to find the minimum number of magical orbs required to create a target potion.
tutorial.approach1: Parse recipes to build a dependency graph
tutorial.approach2: Use memoization to avoid recalculating subproblems
tutorial.approach4: Return minimum orbs and optimal path
tutorial.educationalIntro: This challenge helps farmers and students understand:
tutorial.realWorldText: Similar algorithms are used in crop rotation planning, supply chain optimization, and resource allocation in modern agriculture!
